Udacity Sparkify project using a fictional music-streaming dataset.

Reading churn signals from streaming events

A PySpark workflow that turns listening and interaction logs into churn features and compares classifiers.

PySpark · Spark MLlib · Python · pandas · Matplotlib

The question

Raw event histories need to become customer-level features before churn can be modeled.

The work

  • Clean event logs and aggregate activity at user level.
  • Engineer signals from sessions, songs, artists, playlist additions and feedback.
  • Compare logistic regression, random forest and gradient-boosted trees.
  • Inspect feature importance and tuning results.

What the repository demonstrates

  • Original outputs show behavioral feature importance and how free/paid users split by status.

What I learned

  • Translate event data into interpretable behavioral signals and assess generalization.

Project context

  • Fictional dataset; no real customer retention uplift is claimed.
Source references

This is a curated local case study based on the public project repository, not a rerun of the original analysis.
